Name: WORLD_MAP_PLACE_NAME_PARAM_ST
Description: Appears unused by the game (Elden Ring's world-map region names). Retail: 9 Elden Ring rows, unchanged.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build.

Fields.Name: World Map Piece ID
Fields.Description: Map fragment parameter ID. Display text if you have this map fragment

Fields.Name: Place Name - Text ID
Fields.Description: PlaceName text shown on the map.

Fields.Name: Map Area
Fields.Description: AA part of the mAA_BB_CC_00 map the position is relative to.

Fields.Name: Map Block X
Fields.Description: BB part of the mAA_BB_CC_00 map the position is relative to.

Fields.Name: Map Block Z
Fields.Description: CC part of the mAA_BB_CC_00 map the position is relative to.

Fields.Name: Coordinate: X
Fields.Description: X coordinate of the name, relative to the map set by Map Area / Block X / Block Z.

Fields.Name: Coordinate: Y
Fields.Description: Y (height) coordinate, relative to its map. Read, but the world map is top-down, so it has no visible effect.

Fields.Name: Coordinate: Z
Fields.Description: Z coordinate of the name, relative to the map set by Map Area / Block X / Block Z.
